purpose: Correct the policy interpretation attached to the immutable pre-P0/R1 checkpoint without changing the checkpoint or its content-hashed input manifest.

corrections.superseded_statement: Generator analysis-response memoization is removed so every model-authored analysis is live.
corrections.replacement: Preserve the validated generator's in-memory reuse of identical public contract and repair analyses within one generator lifetime. The memo is never persisted or loaded from a prior run, and removing it would be a deferred generator behavior change.

A live model request means the repository does not replay a persistently stored whole response. OpenAI-managed prompt-prefix computation and the generator's within-run analysis memo are separate mechanisms and must be recorded separately.

Replacement publication runs pin the complete observed operational policy: SDK retries 5; ToolSandbox and generation wrapper delays 1,3 seconds; scenario attempts 4; request timeouts 120 and 600 seconds. The five-retry value restores the preserved July launcher/run setting after validation sample 02 unintentionally used the adapter default of 2.

The researcher clarified on 2026-09-02 that outcome/task-completion similarity is the sole paper performance endpoint. Canonical/reference similarity is descriptive only and cannot fail a sample, restore a registry, authorize a retry, or determine release readiness. The active outcome-only threshold file is content-addressed by the release manifest.

Strict publication execution rejects all known SAGE diagnostic tool exposure and force-call environment variables in both online and frozen arms; the run manifest records an empty active set and the independent verifier requires it.
